texts.orig: (80% of the companies I interviewed, 14 out of 17). In all of these cases, the companies found that their supply was either driving its own demand, or word-of-mouth was strong enough to take care of demand. In the three remaining cases (Rover, TaskRabbit, Zillow), there were clear signs that supply wasn’t an issue and thus resources quickly shifted to demand. And, in one illuminating case, one company realized they weren’t a marketplace at all 🤯.
